name: big-log-atlas
description: Open multi-gigabyte log files without loading them: instant scrolling, search, filters, level colours, follow mode. Pro: JSON/logfmt/syslog/access-log columns, time jump, statistics, merge by time, export, anonymise. Works offline.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Big Log Atlas reads log files directly from the file system of the machine the editor runs on. Open a folder on a normal file system.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Big Log Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample log, search it, filter by level, follow a growing file and try the Pro tools with the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample log
steps.description:
Big Log Atlas opens log files of any size without loading them into memory. Open the short invented sample to follow along, or run "Open As Large Log" on one of your own files (also in the Explorer menu).
[Open Sample Log](command:bigLogAtlas.openSampleLog)
[Open As Large Log](command:bigLogAtlas.openLarge)

steps.title: Search and jump
steps.description:
Press Ctrl+F in the log to search text or a regular expression, F3 for the next match. Ctrl+G jumps to a line number, a percentage such as 50%, or a byte offset such as @1048576.
[Go To Line, Percentage Or Byte Offset](command:bigLogAtlas.goTo)
[Find](command:bigLogAtlas.find)

steps.title: Filter by level or text
steps.description:
Show only errors and warnings, or only the lines that match a text or regular expression. Filtered lines keep their real line numbers.
[Filter By Level](command:bigLogAtlas.filterLevels)
[Clear Filter](command:bigLogAtlas.clearFilter)

steps.title: Follow a growing log
steps.description:
Turn on follow mode to watch a file that is still being written, pause it to read, and bookmark lines you want to come back to.
[Follow File (Tail)](command:bigLogAtlas.toggleFollow)
[Toggle Bookmark On Current Line](command:bigLogAtlas.toggleBookmark)

steps.title: Columns and statistics (Pro trial)
steps.description:
Open the JSON Lines sample, choose a parse profile to get columns and field filters, then show statistics. The first Pro command starts a free 14-day trial on this computer; no key, account or network is needed.
[Open Sample JSON Lines Log](command:bigLogAtlas.openSampleJson)
[Choose Parse Profile](command:bigLogAtlas.chooseProfile)
[Show Statistics](command:bigLogAtlas.statistics)
[Show Licence Status](command:bigLogAtlas.licenceStatus)

bigLogAtlas.maxLineChars.markdownDescription: Characters of a line that are shown in the list. A longer line ends with a marker, and the details pane (select the line) shows more of it.

enumDescriptions: Detect the encoding from the byte order mark and the first bytes of the file.
bigLogAtlas.defaultEncoding.markdownDescription: Encoding used when a log is opened. You can also change it for one log with **Big Log Atlas: Change Encoding**.

bigLogAtlas.indexCache.maxMB.markdownDescription: Largest total size, in megabytes, of the saved line indexes in the extension's storage folder. A saved index lets a log that has not changed open without scanning it again. The oldest indexes are deleted first. `0` turns the saved indexes off.

bigLogAtlas.follow.intervalMs.markdownDescription: How often follow mode looks for new lines, in milliseconds.

bigLogAtlas.filter.maxMatches.markdownDescription: Largest number of matching lines a filter keeps (about 8 bytes each). When a filter finds more, it stops and says so, so that a result is never silently incomplete.

bigLogAtlas.colourLevels.markdownDescription: Colour lines by level (fatal, error, warning, info, debug, trace). Each level also has a letter in the margin, so colour is not the only cue.

bigLogAtlas.export.neutraliseFormulas.markdownDescription: In CSV exports (Pro), put an apostrophe before every cell that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return, so that a spreadsheet shows it as text instead of running it as a formula. Turn off only when you need the exact values and open the files in a program that does not run formulas.
